title: OpenAIAPIOptions
description: Native OpenAI Responses API request options used by Captain's API runtime.

model.title: Model
model.description: OpenAI model identifier used to generate the response.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text, image, file, conversation, and function-result items sent to the model.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: System or developer instructions inserted into the model context.

max_output_tokens.title: Maximum output tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Upper bound covering visible output and reasoning tokens.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature between zero and two.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Reasoning effort and summary configuration for reasoning models.

text.title: Text output
text.description: Plain-text or JSON Schema output configuration.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Native Responses API tool definitions derived from Captain caller tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain derives function tools from runtime Config.Tools and the Spec tool policy.

include.title: Included output data
include.description: Additional response fields requested from the Responses API.

x-captain-option.note: Captain always requests reasoning.encrypted_content for stateless tool loops.

store.title: Store response
store.description: Whether OpenAI stores the generated response for later retrieval.

x-captain-option.note: Captain always disables remote response storage and replays its own history.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether the response is returned as server-sent streaming events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses Responses.NewStreaming for its streaming provider.

background.title: Background
background.description: Whether OpenAI runs the response asynchronously in the background.

x-captain-option.note: Captain expects one foreground streaming response.

max_tool_calls.title: Maximum tool calls
max_tool_calls.description: Maximum total built-in tool calls processed in the response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain bounds its local tool loop rather than setting this native limit.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel tool calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue tool calls in parallel.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose this native option.

previous_response_id.title: Previous response ID
previous_response_id.description: Remote response identifier used for OpenAI-managed conversation state.

x-captain-option.note: Captain replays canonical messages instead of referencing stored responses.

top_logprobs.title: Top log probabilities
top_logprobs.description: Number of likely tokens returned with log probabilities at each position.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not request token log probabilities.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Cumulative probability mass retained during nucleus sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-p Spec field.

prompt_cache_key.title: Prompt cache key
prompt_cache_key.description: Stable key used by OpenAI to improve prompt-cache routing.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send a prompt cache routing key.

safety_identifier.title: Safety identifier
safety_identifier.description: Stable hashed identifier used for abuse detection.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send per-user safety identifiers.

user.title: Legacy user identifier
user.description: Deprecated end-user identifier replaced by safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send the deprecated user field.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Up to sixteen string key-value pairs attached to the response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not forward per-request OpenAI metadata.

prompt.title: Prompt template
prompt.description: Reusable OpenAI prompt template reference and variables.

x-captain-option.note: Captain renders its own prompt and does not select remote prompt templates.

service_tier.title: Service tier
service_tier.description: Processing tier used to serve the response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select an OpenAI service tier.

truncation.title: Truncation
truncation.description: Strategy applied when conversation input exceeds the model context window.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not opt into OpenAI input truncation.

tool_choice.title: Tool choice
tool_choice.description: Policy selecting whether and which tool the model should call.

x-captain-option.note: Captain supplies function tools but does not set Responses tool_choice.
